stories.title: Peeking behind the curtain of the Roger B. Chaffee Planetarium
stories.summary: The Roger B. Chaffee Planetarium in Grand Rapids offers an immersive journey through space, using modern technology to explore the universe.

stories.title: Muskegon Heights considers public safety millage amid deficit crisis
stories.summary: Muskegon Heights faces a financial crisis, with a looming deficit exceeding $3 million. Proposed solutions include a police and fire millage.

stories.title: Crews fight fire at Caledonia grain elevator
stories.summary: Crews are fighting a fire at the grain elevator on East Main Street in downtown Caledonia.

stories.title: Fire destroys Park Township home, sends 2 to hospital
stories.summary: Two people were injured and five homes were evacuated after a fire destroyed a Park Township home Monday afternoon, fire officials said.

stories.title: 'SHELL-SHOCKED' | Family of Ludington teen killed in shooting near Mt. Pleasant speaks out
stories.summary: The family of Destiney Mendez, who was killed Saturday morning near Mount Pleasant, shared more details about her tragic death with 13 ON YOUR SIDE.

stories.title: Woman sentenced 22-60 years for killing of boyfriend in Allegan County
stories.summary: A woman was sentenced to a minimum of 22.5 years in prison for the April 2026 killing of her boyfriend in Allegan County.

stories.title: Grand Rapids zoning change opens door to more housing
stories.summary: The city is making it easier to build accessory dwelling units, or ADUs, hoping to close the gap between available housing and its current demand.

stories.title: GVSU police unveil upgraded command center in Allendale
stories.summary: The upgrades were completed in August at a price tag of just over $200,000.

stories.title: Fox Sports' 'Big Noon Kickoff' will come to Ferris State University for first Division II visit
stories.summary: The appointment was announced one day after Ferris State broke an NCAA Division II record for consecutive wins.

stories.title: Ada woman files federal lawsuit against Lowell, Forest Hills schools
stories.summary: An Ada woman is suing Lowell and Forest Hills schools, alleging she was barred from substitute teaching because of her Christian beliefs.

stories.title: Woman facing open murder charge in Allegan County boyfriend's killing
stories.summary: The Allegan County Sheriff's Office said Jennifer Moore called 911 to tell dispatchers she shot her boyfriend, Joseph Worley.

stories.title: AG Nessel warns of limitations to Michigan's price gouging laws amid FAA ground stop
stories.summary: MI law stops individual retailers from charging prices that are "grossly in excess" of what others are charging for something. What if prices are raised in unison?
